notes: Requirements page: BS in Computer Science, catalog.iit.edu. CS 330 Discrete Structures and CS 331 Data Structures and Algorithms are also required; CS 116 is taken as the next required programming course (C2) and CS 430 as the required algorithms course (C3). No Illinois Tech CS frame course had a public syllabus from Spring 2023 or later. Context only: Illinois Tech has a Generative AI Policy (https://www.iit.edu/sites/default/files/2026-06/Generative%20AI%20Policy.pdf) and suggested syllabus language with three categories (no use, some use, significant use) that leaves the choice to instructors.
